title: Actor collision and lifetime, round4: proven controls and last-result diagnostics
scope: Read-only native IDA research followed by an isolated trainer module; no IDB mutation, executable patch, game process or GUI action.

coverage.note: Capture completeness and a specific semantic finding are distinct. These claims do not establish every branch or all callers.

claims.Finding: Runs dynamic/static lateral resolution, then dynamic/static floor resolution; resets lateral bit4 and the borrowed dynamic-owner pointer before choosing a contact.
claims.Limitations: RCX points to the mutable 136-byte request/result block. Not a pure query.

claims.Finding: Lateral resolver divides travel by block+32 radius, steps the sweep, writes corrected position+48 and sets result+116 bit4 on obstruction/correction.
claims.Limitations: Mutates collider scratch and request/result. A nonpositive or nonfinite radius is unsafe for a new call.

claims.Finding: Builds the vertical segment, probes the mesh, writes floor Y at block+104 and clears invalid-height bit2 on hit; failure sets bit2 before support classification.
claims.Limitations: The function also writes shared collider filters. Do not call from a snapshot getter.

claims.Finding: Stores selected polygon WORD+96, uses FFFF as unavailable, and sets/clears no-accepted-support bit1 after tolerance/extent and polygon classification.
claims.Limitations: Bit1 alone does not prove grounded state; initialized polygon and height cache are required.

claims.Finding: Iterates dynamic floor colliders, skips disabled/self nodes, chooses the native floor result and stores a borrowed node at block+120.
claims.Limitations: The borrowed node can be freed at map teardown and must not be retained or followed from an old snapshot.

claims.Finding: Iterates dynamic wall colliders; node flag2 excludes the node and flag1 excludes its lateral pass; owner-ID equality excludes self geometry.
claims.Limitations: These node flags differ from Actor+288 body-separation flags.

claims.Finding: Builds the Actor support cache from the selected polygon and either the recorded dynamic collider or static map collider; FFFF receives a fallback normal.
claims.Limitations: Fallback is not measured ground. Cached normal is copied only after native cache/polygon checks.

claims.Finding: Builds a temporary request around a position, probes/selects support information, and invokes the support-cache builder.
claims.Limitations: Presence of a surface cache alone does not prove that the Actor's movement resolver ran this frame.

claims.Finding: World-collision gate is Actor+2488 bit1 set, Actor+288 bit1 clear, and no decoded attachment at Actor+1696.
claims.Limitations: Here 'bit1' in the mask means numeric mask0x1. Gate alone does not prove a completed collision evaluation.

claims.Finding: Body-separation gate requires Actor+288 mask2 clear, Actor+2488 mask0x1000 clear, and a nonnull body buffer+2560 with positive count.
claims.Limitations: This is separate from world collision and damage/hurt-shape eligibility.

claims.Finding: Returns mass10000 when Actor+400 mask2 is set; otherwise reads the object's model record float+80.
claims.Limitations: Mass is used by separation weighting, not a general physics-engine mass contract.

claims.Finding: Determines whether separation treats an Actor as immovable using zero mass, Actor+288 mask4, action flags, attachment and stop conditions.
claims.Limitations: Changing mass or this result is not implemented; several independent native owners exist.

claims.Finding: Counts collision-source records of the requested type and allocates24+40*N bytes; header count starts0, owner is+8 and type is+16.
claims.Limitations: Allocation capacity is implied by the source table, not stored explicitly in the buffer header.

claims.Finding: Rebuilds a buffer by zeroing its count and converting active source records into40-byte shapes only when the owner pose-available mask0x400 is set.
claims.Limitations: Direct edits to shape positions/dimensions are overwritten by native pose rebuilding.

claims.Finding: Finds overlapping shape pairs, derives horizontal correction, weights movable Actors by mass and modifies shape centers plus pending Actor correction.
claims.Limitations: Not a pure overlap test. Return value is not a useful stable boolean contract.

claims.Finding: Tailcalls the scene-heap release wrapper for the shape-buffer allocation.
claims.Limitations: The caller's pointer is not automatically cleared; readable freed memory is not lifetime proof.

claims.Finding: Counts20-byte collision-source entries starting at resource+64 whose type byte+4 equals the requested type.
claims.Limitations: Header count and loaded resource extent are prerequisites; malformed resources are outside the native routine's safety contract.

claims.Finding: Iterates source entries selected by a bitmask over their type byte, rather than treating17 as a literal type number.
claims.Limitations: Mask17 selects bits0/4; names for those categories have not been established.

claims.Finding: Converts a source entry into a40-byte shape: type+0, radius+4, height+8, source pointer+16 and transformed center Vec4+24; bone/pose gating can zero dimensions.
claims.Limitations: These are collision proxies, not an asserted final damage hitbox layout for every actor.

claims.Finding: Initializes the Actor world block at+1744, invalid floor state at+1860, polygonFFFF, null dynamic owner; loads collision resource+2744 and allocates body+2560/hurt+1600 buffers.
claims.Limitations: A constructor state with flags2 must not be interpreted as grounded. Static claim covers these initialization paths only.

claims.Finding: Releases both Actor body/hurt shape collections during cleanup.
claims.Limitations: No general generation counter or post-free pointer clearing was identified here.

claims.Finding: Performs Actor cleanup including shape-buffer release and Actor allocation release.
claims.Limitations: A retained Actor pointer can remain readable after this function; live-list/status ownership is required.

claims.Finding: Rebinds a collision resource, updates world dimensions and creates new body/hurt buffers without first releasing the old buffers in this body.
claims.Limitations: No direct runtime caller was found in the examined index. Do not repurpose as a trainer refresh API.

claims.Finding: Runs body-to-body separation via3BA970/40AD70 independently of the world-collision gate and resolver; copies the refreshed support-cache result flags.
claims.Limitations: This distinguishes the proposed body-only bit from the existing complete movement-collision bypass.

claims.Finding: Returns cached floor Y when valid; on an invalid cache it invokes3F3DD0 and writes the Actor cache, possibly clearing the invalid-height bit.
claims.Limitations: Not a side-effect-free getter; the trainer reads the guarded cache directly.

claims.Finding: Returns an action-dependent Actor+256 value for selected descriptors, otherwise shares the mutating floor-cache refresh behavior.
claims.Limitations: Not a universal current-ground getter and not called by diagnostics.

claims.Finding: Writes start/displacement into the live Actor collision block and runs the resolver before returning a result bit.
claims.Limitations: Cannot be used as a harmless 'can move there' test; it changes the live block and shared filters.

claims.Finding: Probes the ground under an Actor and uses the position-setting path when a hit is accepted.
claims.Limitations: Potential snap-to-floor API needs separate caller, action and transition validation; no trainer call is implemented.

claims.Finding: Sets Actor+1876 dynamic-platform/snap tolerance from the decoded platform-parent context and a native constant.
claims.Limitations: The tolerance is context-owned and not exposed as a persistent trainer override.

claims.Finding: Pops a24-byte node from the dynamic-collider pool, constructs its248-byte collider and links the node into the global list.
claims.Limitations: The native allocator assumes available pool capacity; it is not a checked mod allocation API.

claims.Finding: Unlinks a dynamic collider node, releases its collider pointer+8 and returns its index to the free stack.
claims.Limitations: Requires a known current linked node. Never pass a cached or guessed node.

claims.Finding: Iterates dynamic nodes while skipping flag2-disabled nodes.
claims.Limitations: Packed next links and list lifetime still require independent validation.

claims.Finding: Creates map collision wrappers of248 bytes and binds the loaded map collision/environment resources, including static rootABD448.
claims.Limitations: Wrappers are scene-owned; their existence is not permanent process lifetime.

claims.Finding: Releases and nulls the map collider wrapper globals and associated map root during teardown.
claims.Limitations: Snapshots require a current playable scene and fresh root validation.

claims.Finding: Binds a248-byte collider wrapper to resource tables: polygon+24, vertex+32, attribute+40, normal+48, counts+72..84, matrices+100/+164 and scratch flags.
claims.Limitations: Raw header offsets/counts are trusted by native code; this is not a safe arbitrary external-mesh parser.

claims.Finding: Dispatches shape intersection: type1 cylinders, type3 spheres, and supported type0 ellipsoid combinations, with strict overlap comparisons.
claims.Limitations: Unsupported type combinations return false; tangency is not overlap and zero dimensions can divide by zero.

claims.Finding: Derives horizontal separation for supported type0/3 pairs with a native skin allowance of5.
claims.Limitations: Does not resolve arbitrary shapes or vertical penetration; unsupported pairs leave correction unchanged.

claims.Finding: Updates pose/transforms and rebuilds the body-shape buffer+2560 through40B140.
claims.Limitations: Body shape data follows pose lifetime and may be computed on the native motion workers.

claims.Finding: Performs Actor motion work and rebuilds the hurt-shape buffer+1600 after body/pose processing.
claims.Limitations: This worker entry must finish before an external observer assumes stable shape data.

claims.Finding: Queues batches of Actor motion jobs via12FDB0 and waits via130130 before returning; then clears the active work flag.
claims.Limitations: Trainer snapshot placement after the original native update relies on this normal completion path, not arbitrary worker sampling.

claims.Finding: Runs the Actor update phase including3BFD30 and invokes the motion/pose batch processing before post-update processing.
claims.Limitations: A frame may still skip collision for native stop/action states.

claims.Finding: Registers the field Actor-update task and its cleanup and creates the subordinate Actor scheduler with the3BF5E0 callback.
claims.Limitations: Task/scene lifetime is required; merely finding an Actor address is insufficient.

claims.Finding: Iterates collision-source entries and skips entries whose group is disabled by3BA550.
claims.Limitations: Native enabled-shape count can vary with action and group masks within one Actor lifetime.

claims.Finding: Implements the supported mixed ellipsoid/cylinder overlap calculation using radial cross sections.
claims.Limitations: No broad physics-engine interpretation beyond the examined proxy pair is claimed.

claims.Finding: Tests normalized ellipsoid-style squared separation against1 for supported shape pairs.
claims.Limitations: Nonzero dimensions are required; the routine is unsuitable for arbitrary malformed input.

claims.Finding: Builds shape bounds but uses MINSS for subsequent upper bounds as well as lower bounds; full ASM confirms upper X/Y/Z can shrink.
claims.Limitations: This is a literal static anomaly. Visible gameplay impact is not proven; the normal model-bounds path differs.

claims.Finding: Allocates2248 bytes for the dynamic-node pool, initializes80 nodes/free indices and clears dynamic list head/tail.
claims.Limitations: 80 is the pool allocator capacity, not proof that every possible list node must belong to this pool.

claims.Finding: Clears numeric flag1 on a dynamic node.
claims.Limitations: This is a lateral-pass flag operation, not node destruction.

claims.Finding: Constructs/appends a dynamic node provided by the caller instead of allocating it from the80-node pool.

claims.Finding: Ground probe receives startRCX, outputRDX, rangeXMM2, biasXMM3 and a stack mask; writes a fallback output on failure and returns a hit boolean.

claims.Finding: Fetches a plane normal through the polygon's normal index, transforms and normalizes it for a nonidentity collider.
claims.Limitations: Requires valid polygon/normal indices and loaded tables; trainer copies the native cache instead of following these tables.

claims.Finding: Allocates through the current scene heap's virtual allocation slot.
claims.Limitations: Shape collections belong to scene heap9BA920; no cross-scene ownership is implied.

claims.Finding: Releases through the current scene heap's virtual release slot.
claims.Limitations: Calling it after heap replacement with an old allocation is unsafe.

claims.Finding: Clears Actor+288 numeric mask2 on the Actor passed in RDX.

claims.Finding: Sets Actor+288 mask2 but also clears movement vectors and requests native motion/action0xA1.

claims.Finding: Frees the dynamic-node pool and nulls its pool pointer while leaving dynamic list head/tail uncleared in this body.
claims.Limitations: Nonnull list roots can be stale after teardown; never dereference a cached dynamic contact from readability alone.

claims.Finding: Performs map/scene subsystem teardown, including dynamic-pool release before later asset unloads.
claims.Limitations: Confirms transition-time lifetime loss; a scene-ready/heap/scheduler lease must be revalidated.

claims.Finding: Skips normal collision/update work for native stopped/frozen or special action paths while other maintenance can continue.
claims.Limitations: Cached contact data has no proven per-frame freshness token; diagnostics are explicitly last-evaluated results.

claims.Finding: Resolves collision-group enable/disable through Actor action/group bitsets then collision-resource defaults.
claims.Limitations: Do not assign friendly names to undocumented group indices or indiscriminately enable all shapes.

claims.Finding: Iterates20-byte source entries by exact type, with22 as a wildcard selector.
claims.Limitations: The separate3C9BC0 iterator uses type masks and must not be conflated with this API.

claims.Finding: Prize processing uses the same3BA970 body gate on prize actors in its attraction/pickup path.
claims.Limitations: Global application of the separation bit could affect prizes; the new feature changes only the validated current Sora.

claims.Finding: Another prize update path checks the native body-separation gate before attraction/pickup processing.
claims.Limitations: No universal 'noclip all actors' control is proposed.

claims.Finding: Uses transformed model bounds normally; the40AC20 multi-shape bounds fallback is used when model+2696 is absent and a body buffer exists.
claims.Limitations: The MINSS anomaly is limited to this fallback, not asserted for all rendered actors.

claims.Finding: A separate movement/separation pass iterates other actors and honors3BA970 on the relevant body buffers.
claims.Limitations: The mask2 control affects these verified separation consumers, not hit detection.

claims.Finding: Motion worker removes queued callback/context/index triples under its mutex, invokes each callback, then signals its completion semaphore only after the queue is empty.
claims.Limitations: A static ordering guarantee for this native worker loop; arbitrary mods can change scheduling.

claims.Finding: Waits on and releases all six worker completion semaphores at112-byte stride before returning.
claims.Limitations: Together with130030 this establishes the normal post-motion completion barrier.

claims.Finding: Acquires all worker completion semaphores, distributes24-byte job triples across six workers under queue mutexes, then wakes every worker.

claims.Finding: Increments waiter count, calls WaitForSingleObject(handle+8,INFINITE), then decrements waiter count.
claims.Limitations: Used as the completion wait primitive; no timeout/error recovery beyond native behavior is inferred.

claims.Finding: Tailcalls ReleaseSemaphore(handle+8,1,null).
claims.Limitations: A synchronization primitive, not a lifetime allocator.

claims.Finding: Reads Actor pointer from context array at indexEDX and tailcalls3BFAB0 with Actor in RCX.
claims.Limitations: Confirms the motion-worker callback ABI and Actor argument ownership.

claims.Finding: Native stop predicate checks timed stop+1612, category-dependent stop, Actor+288 mask0x400 and global stop context38EE40.
claims.Limitations: The implemented cache filter excludes these known stop branches conservatively; no complete frame-freshness claim.

claims.Finding: Returns numeric flag1 from the timed-state byte pointed to by RCX.

claims.Finding: Returns true if global stop contextBF2AC8 has any nonzero QWORD among four lanes at+80..104.
claims.Limitations: The readout checks these lanes without calling the native routine; unknown/unreadable context suppresses contact interpretation.

fields.40: second radius initialized from same source

shape_buffer.header: int count at0; Actor*owner at8; uint type at16
shape_buffer.shape: uint type0; float radius4; float height8; source record pointer16; Vec4 transformed center24
shape_buffer.lifetime: Scene-heap allocation; native pose workers rebuild contents. Cleanup releases buffers without making all old pointers non-readable.

features.tick_placement: On game thread after original application update and native Actor/motion barrier, before publishing snapshot. Common heartbeat/reset must invoke CollisionReset.

ownership.acquire: Stable living Sora form0..6, validated current Actor/status allocation/list/backlinks and nonempty body buffer; native bit2 and alternate gate0x1000 must initially be clear. CAS adds exactly bit2.
ownership.lease: Actor, allocated status, current form, gameplay scheduler, scene heap and all10 map target bytes; no borrowed collider node retained.
ownership.restore: CAS clears only owned bit2 while identity remains valid. Host expiry, explicit disable, death or bridge disable can release it without requiring positive HP or a fresh host. Replaced/freed/transitioning identities are abandoned without old-pointer writes. A restore CAS conflict relinquishes ownership without retrying against a changed flags word; bit2 can remain set until a native reset. No unconditional restoration guarantee is made.
ownership.native_ownership: If native code clears the bit, ownership is dropped and the bit is not reapplied. Preexisting native bit2 is never acquired.
ownership.limitation: Exact same-address Actor/status reuse with identical checked identity, or native clear-and-set between observations, has no proven generation token. This same-value ABA cannot be distinguished by a retained lease. The feature is bounded to the current native scene and should not be described as a universal noclip mode.

diagnostics.semantics: Read-only last native results. No collision solver, floor probe, shape update or native getter is called.
diagnostics.known_suppression: No contact interpretation during native field pause, movement-collision bypass, Actor/global/timed stop, unresolved category-stop branch, missing static map collider or unready player. Invalid-cache flag/sentinel/nonfinite Y suppress contact/normal fields.
diagnostics.normal: Copy the native cached normal, require a selected polygon and an approximately unit finite vector. The borrowed dynamic node is only tested for null, not dereferenced.
diagnostics.limits: No per-result frame/generation stamp is proven. Other native action paths can skip collision; surviving finite cache values remain last-evaluated values, not a new test of current geometry. The shape capacity bound4096 is trainer policy.
